spanish: Y tú hablarás a todos sabios de corazón que lo llené espíritu de sabiduría, y harán los vestidos de Aarón para santificarlo, para que él sacerdotee a mí.
grammarChanges: Supplied explicit subject 'él' via a subjunctive clause ('para que él sacerdotee a mí') to carry the 3ms suffix on the piel infinitive לְכַהֲנוֹ (h02028003016), which had no overt argument in the draft's bare infinitive 'para sacerdotear a mí'; the 1cs 'a mí' (h02028003017) is unchanged.
readerNote: Grammatical choice: added the subject él (referring back to the already-established Aarón, not a new participant) because Spanish infinitives cannot carry the 3ms suffix that the Hebrew piel infinitive construct does.
